t: This is Holland Road in Kensington, which links Kensington High Street with the Holland Park roundabout. Its southern end is one-way and forms part of the Kensington and Earl's Court one-way system. The comedian Norman Clapham, who performed as John Henry, lived here and died here. He did pioneering work in radio comedy and made some of its earliest commercial recordings. His story ended sadly: he took his own life after the death of his stage partner, Gladys Horridge.
